newsitem.title: USA: Chantal Pharmaceutical hires new accountant.
newsitem.headline: Chantal Pharmaceutical hires new accountant.

text.p: Chantal Pharmaceutical Corp said Tuesday it has hired BDO Seidman LLP as its new independent certified public accountant, replacing Coopers & Lybrand LLP, which resigned without explanation in August.
BDO is the seventh-largest firm of accountants and consultants in the world and has begun working on the audit of the company's fiscal 1996 financial statements.
When Coopers & Lybrand resigned, it was the company's independent accountant for the June 30, 1996 audit.
Coopers & Lybrand did not disclose the reasons for its resignation.
